blurb: Guests rent boats, jet skis, and UTVs to explore lakes and rugged terrain in Utah. Rentals include fishing/cruiser pontoon boats, sport pontoon boats, Moomba Max wake boats, and various jet skis. UTV tours and rentals are available near St. George, with access to Sand Hollow Recreation Area and nearby waterparks.
